21	class RegReadPort extends Bundle {
22	  val valid = Input(Bool())
23	  val addr  = Input(UInt(5.W))
24	  val data  = Output(UInt(32.W))
25	}
26	
27	/** Write port for the integer register file. */
28	class RegWritePort extends Bundle {
29	  val valid = Input(Bool())
30	  val addr  = Input(UInt(5.W))
31	  val data  = Input(UInt(32.W))
32	}
33	
34	/** Integer register file (RV32 — 32 × 32-bit registers).
35	  *
36	  * Register x0 is hardwired to 0 and ignores writes.
37	  * Supports parameterised numbers of read and write ports.
38	  *
39	  * Scoreboard: tracks in-flight (pending writeback) registers.
40	  *   - `scoreboard_set` sets bits for newly-issued instructions.
41	  *   - Write port completion clears the corresponding scoreboard bit.
42	  */
43	class Regfile(p: Parameters, numReadPorts: Int, numWritePorts: Int) extends Module {
44	  val io = IO(new Bundle {
45	    val read_ports     = Vec(numReadPorts,  new RegReadPort)
46	    val write_ports    = Vec(numWritePorts, new RegWritePort)
47	    val scoreboard      = Output(UInt(32.W))
48	    val scoreboard_set  = Input(UInt(32.W))
49	    val exception       = Output(Bool())
50	  })
51	
52	  // -----------------------------------------------------------------------
53	  // Register storage (reg(0) is always 0)
54	  // -----------------------------------------------------------------------
55	  val regs = RegInit(VecInit(Seq.fill(32)(0.U(32.W))))
56	
57	  // -----------------------------------------------------------------------
58	  // Scoreboard
59	  // -----------------------------------------------------------------------
60	  val scoreboard = RegInit(0.U(32.W))
61	
62	  val clearMask = Wire(UInt(32.W))
63	  clearMask := 0.U
64	  for (i <- 0 until numWritePorts) {
65	    when(io.write_ports(i).valid) {
66	      clearMask := clearMask | (1.U << io.write_ports(i).addr)
67	    }
68	  }
69	  scoreboard := (scoreboard | io.scoreboard_set) & ~clearMask
70	  io.scoreboard := scoreboard
71	
72	  // -----------------------------------------------------------------------
73	  // Write ports (port 0 has highest priority on conflict)
74	  // -----------------------------------------------------------------------
75	  for (i <- 0 until numWritePorts) {
76	    when(io.write_ports(i).valid && io.write_ports(i).addr =/= 0.U) {
77	      regs(io.write_ports(i).addr) := io.write_ports(i).data
78	    }
79	  }
80	
81	  // -----------------------------------------------------------------------
82	  // Read ports (combinational; x0 always returns 0)
83	  // -----------------------------------------------------------------------
84	  for (i <- 0 until numReadPorts) {
85	    io.read_ports(i).data := Mux(
86	      io.read_ports(i).addr === 0.U,
87	      0.U,
88	      regs(io.read_ports(i).addr)
89	    )
90	  }
91	
92	  // -----------------------------------------------------------------------
93	  // Exception: two write ports targeting the same non-zero register
94	  // -----------------------------------------------------------------------
95	  val exc = Wire(Bool())
96	  exc := false.B
97	  if (numWritePorts > 1) {
98	    for (i <- 0 until numWritePorts) {
99	      for (j <- i + 1 until numWritePorts) {
100	        when(io.write_ports(i).valid && io.write_ports(j).valid &&
101	             io.write_ports(i).addr === io.write_ports(j).addr &&
102	             io.write_ports(i).addr =/= 0.U) {
103	          exc := true.B
104	        }
105	      }
106	    }
107	  }
108	  io.exception := exc
109	}

20	/** Execution unit target for a decoded instruction. */
21	object ExecUnit extends ChiselEnum {
22	  val ALU   = Value
23	  val MLU   = Value
24	  val DVU   = Value
25	  val FPU   = Value
26	  val LSU   = Value
27	  val BRU   = Value
28	  val CSR   = Value
29	  val SYS   = Value  // fence, ecall, ebreak, mret
30	  val RVV   = Value  // vector instructions
31	  val NOP   = Value
32	}
33	
34	/** Decoded instruction bundle passed to the issue stage. */
35	class DecodedInst extends Bundle {
36	  val valid     = Bool()
37	  val pc        = UInt(32.W)
38	  val inst      = UInt(32.W)
39	  val execUnit  = ExecUnit()
40	  val rs1Addr   = UInt(5.W)
41	  val rs2Addr   = UInt(5.W)
42	  val rs1Valid  = Bool()  // instruction uses rs1
43	  val rs2Valid  = Bool()  // instruction uses rs2
44	  val rdAddr    = UInt(5.W)
45	  val rdValid   = Bool()  // instruction writes rd
46	  val imm       = SInt(32.W)
47	  val isFloat   = Bool()  // floating-point instruction
48	  val exception = Bool()  // illegal instruction or other decode fault
49	}
50	
51	/** Instruction decoder.
52	  *
53	  * Converts a raw 32-bit RISC-V instruction into a DecodedInst bundle.
54	  * Supports RV32IMAF_Zbb_Zve32x.
55	  *
56	  * Combinational (no pipeline register here; the decode stage register is
57	  * external to this module).
58	  */
59	class Decode(p: Parameters) extends Module {
60	  val io = IO(new Bundle {
61	    val inst    = Input(UInt(32.W))
62	    val pc      = Input(UInt(32.W))
63	    val valid   = Input(Bool())
64	    val decoded = Output(new DecodedInst)
65	  })
66	
67	  // -----------------------------------------------------------------------
68	  // Instruction field extraction
69	  // -----------------------------------------------------------------------
70	  val opcode = io.inst(6, 0)
71	  val rd     = io.inst(11, 7)
72	  val funct3 = io.inst(14, 12)
73	  val rs1    = io.inst(19, 15)
74	  val rs2    = io.inst(24, 20)
75	  val funct7 = io.inst(31, 25)
76	
77	  // Immediate value extraction
78	  val immI = Cat(Fill(21, io.inst(31)), io.inst(30, 20)).asSInt
79	  val immS = Cat(Fill(21, io.inst(31)), io.inst(30, 25), io.inst(11, 7)).asSInt
80	  val immB = Cat(Fill(20, io.inst(31)), io.inst(7), io.inst(30, 25),
81	                  io.inst(11, 8), 0.U(1.W)).asSInt
82	  val immU = Cat(io.inst(31, 12), 0.U(12.W)).asSInt
83	  val immJ = Cat(Fill(12, io.inst(31)), io.inst(19, 12), io.inst(20),
84	                  io.inst(30, 21), 0.U(1.W)).asSInt
85	
86	  // -----------------------------------------------------------------------
87	  // Default decoded values
88	  // -----------------------------------------------------------------------
89	  val dec = Wire(new DecodedInst)
90	  dec.valid     := io.valid
91	  dec.pc        := io.pc
92	  dec.inst      := io.inst
93	  dec.execUnit  := ExecUnit.NOP
94	  dec.rs1Addr   := rs1
95	  dec.rs2Addr   := rs2
96	  dec.rs1Valid  := false.B
97	  dec.rs2Valid  := false.B
98	  dec.rdAddr    := rd
99	  dec.rdValid   := false.B
100	  dec.imm       := immI
101	  dec.isFloat   := false.B
102	  dec.exception := false.B
103	
104	  // -----------------------------------------------------------------------
105	  // Decode table (abbreviated subset — enough to compile)
106	  // -----------------------------------------------------------------------
107	  switch(opcode) {
108	    is("b0110011".U) {  // R-type integer
109	      dec.rs1Valid := true.B; dec.rs2Valid := true.B; dec.rdValid := true.B
110	      dec.execUnit := Mux(funct7 === "b0000001".U,
111	        Mux(funct3(2), ExecUnit.DVU, ExecUnit.MLU),
112	        ExecUnit.ALU)
113	    }
114	    is("b0010011".U) {  // I-type integer
115	      dec.rs1Valid := true.B; dec.rdValid := true.B
116	      dec.execUnit := ExecUnit.ALU; dec.imm := immI
117	    }
118	    is("b0000011".U) {  // LOAD
119	      dec.rs1Valid := true.B; dec.rdValid := true.B
120	      dec.execUnit := ExecUnit.LSU; dec.imm := immI
121	    }
122	    is("b0100011".U) {  // STORE
123	      dec.rs1Valid := true.B; dec.rs2Valid := true.B
124	      dec.execUnit := ExecUnit.LSU; dec.imm := immS
125	    }
126	    is("b1100011".U) {  // BRANCH
127	      dec.rs1Valid := true.B; dec.rs2Valid := true.B
128	      dec.execUnit := ExecUnit.BRU; dec.imm := immB
129	    }
130	    is("b1101111".U) {  // JAL
131	      dec.rdValid := true.B
132	      dec.execUnit := ExecUnit.BRU; dec.imm := immJ
133	    }
134	    is("b1100111".U) {  // JALR
135	      dec.rs1Valid := true.B; dec.rdValid := true.B
136	      dec.execUnit := ExecUnit.BRU; dec.imm := immI
137	    }
138	    is("b0110111".U) {  // LUI
139	      dec.rdValid := true.B
140	      dec.execUnit := ExecUnit.ALU; dec.imm := immU
141	    }
142	    is("b0010111".U) {  // AUIPC
143	      dec.rdValid := true.B
144	      dec.execUnit := ExecUnit.ALU; dec.imm := immU
145	    }
146	    is("b1110011".U) {  // SYSTEM (CSR, ECALL, EBREAK, MRET)
147	      dec.rs1Valid := true.B; dec.rdValid := true.B
148	      dec.execUnit := Mux(funct3 =/= 0.U, ExecUnit.CSR, ExecUnit.SYS)
149	    }
150	    is("b0001111".U) {  // FENCE
151	      dec.execUnit := ExecUnit.SYS
152	    }
153	    // FP load/store
154	    is("b0000111".U) {
155	      dec.rs1Valid := true.B; dec.rdValid := true.B
156	      dec.execUnit := ExecUnit.LSU; dec.isFloat := true.B; dec.imm := immI
157	    }
158	    is("b0100111".U) {
159	      dec.rs1Valid := true.B; dec.rs2Valid := true.B
160	      dec.execUnit := ExecUnit.LSU; dec.isFloat := true.B; dec.imm := immS
161	    }
162	    // FP compute (F extension)
163	    is("b1010011".U) {
164	      dec.rs1Valid := true.B; dec.rs2Valid := true.B; dec.rdValid := true.B
165	      dec.execUnit := ExecUnit.FPU; dec.isFloat := true.B
166	    }
167	    is("b1000011".U, "b1000111".U, "b1001011".U, "b1001111".U) {  // FMADD etc.
168	      dec.rs1Valid := true.B; dec.rs2Valid := true.B; dec.rdValid := true.B
169	      dec.execUnit := ExecUnit.FPU; dec.isFloat := true.B
170	    }
171	    // RVV
172	    is("b1010111".U) {
173	      dec.rs1Valid := true.B; dec.rs2Valid := true.B
174	      dec.execUnit := ExecUnit.RVV
175	    }
176	  }
177	
178	  io.decoded := dec
179	}

20	/** L0 instruction-cache-backed fetch controller.
21	  *
22	  * This wraps either a cached or uncached fetch path depending on the
23	  * `p.enableFetchL0` parameter.  In both cases the external interface
24	  * is identical to FetchControl.
25	  */
26	class Fetch(p: Parameters) extends Module {
27	  val NumInstsPerFetch = 8
28	
29	  val io = IO(new Bundle {
30	    val fetchAddr     = Decoupled(UInt(32.W))
31	    val fetchData     = Flipped(Valid(new FetchData(NumInstsPerFetch)))
32	    val bufferRequest = new BulkRequestIO
33	    val bufferSpaces  = Input(UInt(5.W))
34	    val branch        = Flipped(Valid(UInt(32.W)))
35	    val csr           = new CsrReadPort(1)
36	  })
37	
38	  // Instantiate the uncached fetch controller as the underlying implementation.
39	  // A cached version (L1ICache backed) would be swapped in for the full design.
40	  val ctrl = Module(new FetchControl(p))
41	
42	  ctrl.io.fetchAddr     <> io.fetchAddr
43	  ctrl.io.fetchData     <> io.fetchData
44	  ctrl.io.bufferRequest <> io.bufferRequest
45	  ctrl.io.bufferSpaces  := io.bufferSpaces
46	  ctrl.io.branch        <> io.branch
47	  ctrl.io.csr.value(0)  := io.csr.value(0)
48	}

17	/** Parameters for the CoralNPU processor core.
18	  *
19	  * These are mutable so that tests and generator flags can override defaults.
20	  */
21	class Parameters {
22	  // Data bus widths
23	  var lsuDataBits: Int = 128    // LSU / vector data bus width in bits (128 or 256)
24	  var fetchDataBits: Int = 256  // Instruction fetch bus width in bits (256 = 8x32-bit instructions)
25	
26	  // AXI2 master port (wide, for DRAM/TCM DMA)
27	  var axi2DataBits: Int = 256   // AXI2 master data bus width in bits
28	  var axi2IdBits: Int = 4       // AXI2 master ID field width
29	  var axi2AddrBits: Int = 32    // AXI2 address width
30	
31	  // CSR / narrow AXI port
32	  var csrDataBits: Int = 64     // CSR AXI data bus width in bits
33	
34	  // Memory sizes
35	  var itcmSizeKBytes: Int = 8   // Instruction TCM size in KiB
36	  var dtcmSizeKBytes: Int = 32  // Data TCM size in KiB
37	
38	  // Optional features
39	  var enableFloat: Boolean = false     // Enable scalar FPU (F extension)
40	  var enableRvv: Boolean = false       // Enable RVV (Zve32x)
41	  var enableFetchL0: Boolean = true    // Enable L0 instruction cache
42	  var enableVerification: Boolean = false  // Enable RVVI trace port
43	
44	  // Pipeline / microarchitecture
45	  var numSlots: Int = 4         // Number of issue/retirement slots
46	  var moduleName: String = "Core"  // Top-level module name for emission
47	  var useAxi: Boolean = false   // Expose AXI master port (vs TL-UL)
48	  var useTlul: Boolean = false  // Expose TL-UL master port
49	
50	  def copy(): Parameters = {
51	    val p = new Parameters
52	    p.lsuDataBits        = lsuDataBits
53	    p.fetchDataBits      = fetchDataBits
54	    p.axi2DataBits       = axi2DataBits
55	    p.axi2IdBits         = axi2IdBits
56	    p.axi2AddrBits       = axi2AddrBits
57	    p.csrDataBits        = csrDataBits
58	    p.itcmSizeKBytes     = itcmSizeKBytes
59	    p.dtcmSizeKBytes     = dtcmSizeKBytes
60	    p.enableFloat        = enableFloat
61	    p.enableRvv          = enableRvv
62	    p.enableFetchL0      = enableFetchL0
63	    p.enableVerification = enableVerification
64	    p.numSlots           = numSlots
65	    p.moduleName         = moduleName
66	    p.useAxi             = useAxi
67	    p.useTlul            = useTlul
68	    p
69	  }
70	}

36	    val cmdWrite  = Input(Bool())

40	    val cmdDone   = Output(Bool())

46	  }

50	      dut.clock.step()  // Clear reset.
51	      // Upstream can accept 16 buffers
52	      dut.io.bufferRequest.nReady.poke(8.U)
53	      dut.io.bufferSpaces.poke(16.U)
54	      dut.io.branch.valid.poke(true.B)
55	      dut.io.branch.bits.poke(0x30000000.U)
56	      dut.io.fetchData.valid.poke(true.B)

58	      for (i <- 0 until dut.io.fetchData.bits.inst.length) {

61	      dut.io.bufferRequest.nValid.expect(0.U)
62	      dut.io.fetchAddr.valid.expect(0)
63	      dut.clock.step()
64	
65	      // Resolve the branch
66	      dut.io.branch.valid.poke(false.B)
67	      dut.io.bufferRequest.nValid.expect(0.U)
68	      dut.clock.step()  // Temporary
69	
70	      // Initiate new fetch
71	      dut.io.fetchData.valid.poke(false.B)
72	      dut.io.fetchAddr.valid.expect(1)
73	      dut.io.fetchAddr.bits.expect(0x30000000)

20	/** InstructionBuffer: a windowed instruction FIFO.
21	  *
22	  * @param gen    Data type of each element.
23	  * @param n      Number of elements that can be fed in per cycle.
24	  * @param window Visible window size (how many outputs are shown).
25	  *
26	  * Interface:
27	  *   feedIn.nValid  : number of valid elements being provided this cycle
28	  *   feedIn.nReady  : number of new elements accepted per cycle (= n)
29	  *   feedIn.bits    : Vec(n) of input elements
30	  *   out            : Vec(window, Valid(gen)) - visible window of buffered data
31	  *   nEnqueued      : total number of elements currently buffered
32	  *   nSpace         : total space remaining (capacity - nEnqueued)
33	  *   nDequeued      : number to remove from the front each cycle
34	  *   flush          : clears the buffer
35	  *
36	  * The out(i).ready signals are used to dequeue: the number of ready=true
37	  * outputs from the beginning of out are dequeued.
38	  * (out(0).ready=1, out(1).ready=1 dequeues 2 from the front)
39	  */
40	class InstructionBuffer[T <: Data](gen: T, n: Int, window: Int) extends Module {
41	  // window is the total buffer capacity; n is the max elements per cycle
42	  val capacity = window
43	
44	  val io = IO(new Bundle {
45	    val feedIn = new Bundle {
46	      val nValid = Input(UInt(log2Ceil(n + 1).W))
47	      val nReady = Output(UInt(log2Ceil(n + 1).W))
48	      val bits   = Input(Vec(n, gen))
49	    }
50	    val out       = Vec(n, new DecoupledIO(gen))
51	    val nEnqueued = Output(UInt(log2Ceil(capacity + 1).W))
52	    val nSpace    = Output(UInt(log2Ceil(capacity + 1).W))
53	    val flush     = Input(Bool())
54	  })
55	
56	  val state = RegInit(FIFOState.init(capacity, gen))
57	
58	  // Count how many consecutive out().ready signals are set from the front
59	  // Only contiguous ready signals from index 0 count for dequeue
60	  val nDeqVec = Wire(Vec(n + 1, Bool()))
61	  nDeqVec(0) := true.B
62	  for (i <- 0 until n) {
63	    nDeqVec(i + 1) := nDeqVec(i) && io.out(i).ready
64	  }
65	  // Count how many consecutive readys from front
66	  val nDeqCount = Wire(UInt(log2Ceil(n + 1).W))
67	  nDeqCount := 0.U
68	  for (i <- 0 until n) {
69	    when(nDeqVec(i + 1)) {
70	      nDeqCount := (i + 1).U
71	    }
72	  }
73	
74	  // Also cap by nEnqueued
75	  val actualDeq = Mux(nDeqCount > state.count, state.count, nDeqCount)
76	
77	  // Chain: dequeue then enqueue
78	  val deqState = state.dequeue(actualDeq)
79	  val enqVec   = Wire(Vec(n, gen))
80	  for (i <- 0 until n) enqVec(i) := io.feedIn.bits(i)
81	  val enqState = deqState.enqueue(enqVec, io.feedIn.nValid)
82	
83	  state := Mux(io.flush, state.flush(), enqState)
84	
85	  // Outputs
86	  io.nEnqueued      := state.count
87	  io.nSpace         := (capacity.U - state.count)
88	  io.feedIn.nReady  := n.U  // always accept n per cycle
89	
90	  // Out window: show front n elements of buffered data
91	  val peeked = state.peek(n)
92	  for (i <- 0 until n) {
93	    io.out(i).valid := (i.U < state.count)
94	    io.out(i).bits  := peeked(i)
95	  }
96	}

content.text:
`circt.stage.ChiselStage` is present in the jar. The issue is that the error says `object stage is not a member of package chisel3.util.circt`. This means Scala is resolving `circt` as `chisel3.util.circt` — because of the wildcard import `chisel3.util._`. Let me check the exact error again:

The error is: `object stage is not a member of package chisel3.util.circt`. This means the compiler is finding `chisel3.util.circt` package first and trying to interpret `circt.stage.ChiselStage` as relative to it.

Looking at the files, our `DBus2Axi.scala` has the import inside the `App` object body, which means with `import chisel3.util._` at the top, the `circt` name resolves to `chisel3.util.circt` instead of the top-level `circt` package. The fix is to use `_root_.circt.stage.ChiselStage` as the fully qualified import.

The Mlu tests pass. The ALU tests fail because of line 117 in Alu.scala: `High index 5 is out of range [0, 4]`. Let me look at what's on line 117:

Line 117 in Alu.scala is `result := Mux(rs1 === 0.U, 32.U, PriorityEncoder(Reverse(rs1)))`.

The issue is that `PriorityEncoder(Reverse(rs1))` returns a value that's `log2Ceil(32) = 5` bits wide (indices 0-31 need 5 bits), but when we index `(5, 0)` of it... wait, that's for CTZ. Let me look at the actual lines:

Line 117 is CTZ: `PriorityEncoder(rs1)(5, 0)`. The issue is that `PriorityEncoder(rs1)` of a 32-bit value returns a 5-bit result (indices 0 to 31), so valid bits are `[4:0]` only. Selecting `[5:0]` is out of range because bit 5 doesn't exist in a 5-bit value.

The fix: `PriorityEncoder(rs1)` already returns a value of width `log2Ceil(32) = 5` bits. We should either use it directly (zero-extended to 32 bits for assignment) or just cast. Since we're assigning to a 32-bit `result`, we can just omit the bit-select or use a proper cast:

`result := Mux(rs1 === 0.U, 32.U, PriorityEncoder(rs1))`

The `PriorityEncoder` result (5-bit) will be zero-extended to 32 bits when assigned. Actually wait - `result` is declared as `UInt(32.W)`. So assigning a 5-bit value should be fine since Chisel pads with zeros. The issue is the `(5, 0)` selector — that means bits 5 down to 0 which is 6 bits, but the PE output is only 5 bits wide. 104	// ============================================================================
105	// Fabric arbitration and multiplexing
106	// ============================================================================
107	
108	/** N-to-1 fabric arbiter.
109	  *
110	  * Arbitrates between `n` source ports and forwards the highest-priority
111	  * (lowest index) active request to the single output port.  Read-data
112	  * from the output port is broadcast to all sources.
113	  *
114	  * Priority: source 0 > source 1 > … > source n-1.
115	  *
116	  * `fabricBusy(i)` is asserted when a lower-indexed source has an active
117	  * request, so source `i` must wait.
118	  */
119	class FabricArbiter(p: Parameters, n: Int = 2,
120	                    dataBits: Int = 32, addrBits: Int = 32) extends Module {
121	  val io = IO(new Bundle {
122	    val source     = Vec(n, new FabricSourcePort(dataBits, addrBits))
123	    val port       = new FabricOutPort(dataBits, addrBits)
124	    val fabricBusy = Output(Vec(n, Bool()))
125	  })
126	
127	  // -------------------------------------------------------------------
128	  // Find the highest-priority (lowest index) active source.
129	  // -------------------------------------------------------------------
130	  val activeRead  = VecInit(io.source.map(s => s.readDataAddr.valid))
131	  val activeWrite = VecInit(io.source.map(s => s.writeDataAddr.valid))
132	  val activeAny   = VecInit((activeRead zip activeWrite).map { case (r, w) => r || w })
133	
134	  // Winner index: lowest active source (-1 / "none" encoded as n)
135	  val winnerIdx = Wire(UInt((log2Ceil(n) + 1).W))
136	  winnerIdx := n.U
137	  for (i <- (n - 1) to 0 by -1) {
138	    when(activeAny(i)) { winnerIdx := i.U }
139	  }
140	
141	  // fabricBusy(i): true if any source with index < i has an active request
142	  for (i <- 0 until n) {
143	    // Busy if the winner index is lower than i
144	    io.fabricBusy(i) := (winnerIdx < i.U)
145	  }
146	
147	  // -------------------------------------------------------------------
148	  // Forward winning source → port
149	  // -------------------------------------------------------------------
150	  // Defaults (no request)
151	  io.port.readDataAddr.valid  := false.B
152	  io.port.readDataAddr.bits   := 0.U
153	  io.port.writeDataAddr.valid := false.B
154	  io.port.writeDataAddr.bits  := 0.U
155	  io.port.writeDataBits       := 0.U
156	  io.port.writeDataStrb       := 0.U
157	
158	  for (i <- (n - 1) to 0 by -1) {
159	    when(winnerIdx === i.U) {
160	      io.port.readDataAddr.valid  := io.source(i).readDataAddr.valid
161	      io.port.readDataAddr.bits   := io.source(i).readDataAddr.bits
162	      io.port.writeDataAddr.valid := io.source(i).writeDataAddr.valid
163	      io.port.writeDataAddr.bits  := io.source(i).writeDataAddr.bits
164	      io.port.writeDataBits       := io.source(i).writeDataBits
165	      io.port.writeDataStrb       := io.source(i).writeDataStrb
166	    }
167	  }
168	
169	  // -------------------------------------------------------------------
170	  // Broadcast read-data from port → all sources
171	  // -------------------------------------------------------------------
172	  for (i <- 0 until n) {
173	    io.source(i).readData.valid := io.port.readData.valid
174	    io.source(i).readData.bits  := io.port.readData.bits
175	  }
176	}
177	
178	// ============================================================================
179	// Fabric address multiplexer (1 source → N ports by address decode)
180	// ============================================================================
181	
182	/** 1-to-N fabric address demultiplexer.
183	  *
184	  * Routes a single source port to one of N output ports based on the
185	  * address range of each MemoryRegion.  Addresses within a region are
186	  * translated to region-relative offsets before forwarding.
187	  *
188	  * Read-data from the matching port is forwarded back to the source.
189	  * `periBusy(i)` is passed through to `fabricBusy`.
190	  */
191	class FabricMux(p: Parameters, regions: Seq[MemoryRegion],
192	                dataBits: Int = 32, addrBits: Int = 32) extends Module {
193	  val n = regions.length
194	
195	  val io = IO(new Bundle {
196	    val source     = new FabricSourcePort(dataBits, addrBits)
197	    val ports      = Vec(n, new FabricOutPort(dataBits, addrBits))
198	    val periBusy   = Input(Vec(n, Bool()))
199	    val fabricBusy = Output(Bool())
200	  })
201	
202	  // -------------------------------------------------------------------
203	  // Address decode: which region does this address fall into?
204	  // -------------------------------------------------------------------
205	  def inRegion(addr: UInt, r: MemoryRegion): Bool =
206	    (addr >= r.base.U) && (addr < (r.base + r.size).U)
207	
208	  // Defaults
209	  for (j <- 0 until n) {
210	    io.ports(j).readDataAddr.valid  := false.B
211	    io.ports(j).readDataAddr.bits   := 0.U
212	    io.ports(j).writeDataAddr.valid := false.B
213	    io.ports(j).writeDataAddr.bits  := 0.U
214	    io.ports(j).writeDataBits       := 0.U
215	    io.ports(j).writeDataStrb       := 0.U
216	  }
217	
218	  for (j <- 0 until n) {
219	    val r = regions(j)
220	    // Read path
221	    when(io.source.readDataAddr.valid && inRegion(io.source.readDataAddr.bits, r)) {
222	      io.ports(j).readDataAddr.valid := true.B
223	      io.ports(j).readDataAddr.bits  := io.source.readDataAddr.bits - r.base.U
224	    }
225	    // Write path
226	    when(io.source.writeDataAddr.valid && inRegion(io.source.writeDataAddr.bits, r)) {
227	      io.ports(j).writeDataAddr.valid := true.B
228	      io.ports(j).writeDataAddr.bits  := io.source.writeDataAddr.bits - r.base.U
229	      io.ports(j).writeDataBits       := io.source.writeDataBits
230	      io.ports(j).writeDataStrb       := io.source.writeDataStrb
231	    }
232	  }
233	
234	  // -------------------------------------------------------------------
235	  // Read-data mux: return data from the port whose readData.valid is set
236	  // -------------------------------------------------------------------
237	  io.source.readData.valid := io.ports.map(_.readData.valid).reduce(_ || _)
238	  io.source.readData.bits  := MuxCase(0.U,
239	    (0 until n).map(j => io.ports(j).readData.valid -> io.ports(j).readData.bits))
240	
241	  // -------------------------------------------------------------------
242	  // fabricBusy: OR of all periBusy inputs
243	  // -------------------------------------------------------------------
244	  io.fabricBusy := io.periBusy.reduce(_ || _)
245	}
